title: 8th anal Český Ráj birthday hash!
description: Here we go again! This year will be the big 4-0 for me (Gobbles)! Let's make it a good one! Bring your friends, family, neighbors, and of course your beers 😂! We will meet as usual at Camp Sedmihorky in Český Ráj national park on the 10th of May and stay until the 12th. I know it seems early for this event, but the website opened up for booking last week, and cabins are moving fast. Several of us have already booked and the "mobile home" cabins are already completely gone, and many of the bigger cabins as well. If you want to stay in a cabin, book soon. if you plan to camp, just show up, no reservations needed. There is one proper restaurant and a couple other občerstvení style so you don't really need to bring much except cash. We do however, usually bring some grills and have a big bbq on Saturday afternoon, so you can bring something you'd like to throw on there if you'd like, but we always have a ton of food so not required. Don't forget your ID, cash for food/drinks, and a warm jacket, even if it seems warm, it usually gets very cold at night sitting outside drinking late. This is a pay-as-you-go event, no hash cash. We usually have a circle on Saturday afternoon and down down beers will be provided. https://www.campsedmihorky.cz/en/home camp website for booking Hope to see you there! On On! -Gobbles [redacted]
